sampling.tree_order: first up to 3 matching TTree keys in ROOT file order
sampling.method: PCG64 fixed-seed simple random sampling of raw entry positions without replacement over each entire selected tree; reconstructed-truth selection afterward

formulas.momentum: sum daughters, p=(pt*cos(phi),pt*sin(phi),pt*sinh(eta)); saved He3 momentum used as physical momentum, scale=1
formulas.cos_pa: (p dot d)/(|p| |d|), without clipping or selection
formulas.mass_diagnostic_regions: strict MC window 2.95<m<3.02; data outside that window includes m<=2.95 or m>=3.02

limitations: Only the first up to three physical tree shards are inspected; within each selected shard the entry sample is uniform. Other shards may differ.
Femto values are pair-weighted, reuse candidates/events, and are not an independent-candidate sample. No candidate IDs are constructed.
MCHyper generated-only rows are excluded before deriving reco observables; the main sample requires IsReco & IsSignal & IsTwoBodyDecay.
No extra cosPA, ct, radius, BDT or analysis selection is imposed; quoted mass regions are diagnostics only.
Local producer source documents current storage semantics but is not an authenticated production revision embedded in these ROOT files.
The producer configurable default v0CosPaCut is 0.95; exact historical production cuts cannot be inferred from that default alone.
Sampling fractions are descriptive. No independent-pair uncertainty or physical signal efficiency is inferred.
Aggregate samples use the same 100000-raw-entry quota per selected shard; different-size shards are not population-weighted in combined quantiles. Per-shard distributions are provided.

conclusion.derive_subtracting_primary_again: inconsistent with producer and spectrum formulas; double subtraction of primary vertex
conclusion.momentum_convention: He3 Pt stored after charge-two conversion; do not multiply by two again
conclusion.existing_direct_reference_branches: none in the inspected ROOT trees
conclusion.recommended_fix: Use XDec/YDec/ZDec directly for these O2 schemas; if absolute-SV inputs are supported, require an explicit schema/config convention, never infer from desired cosPA or clip selections to hide disagreement.

recommended_validation_checks: For displacement schemas, varying primary-vertex coordinates while keeping stored decay displacement and daughter momenta fixed must not change cosPA, decay_radius or ct.

For an explicitly supported absolute-SV schema, simultaneous translation of primary and secondary vertices must leave derived observables invariant; never choose a convention by forcing cosPA toward unity.
Use the same explicit vertex convention in training Hyper/MCHyper, working-point candidates, Femto and MCFemto; invalidate all physics-dependent prepared/model/score-cache/downstream signatures.

After retraining, verify raw-margin scores against ModelHandler.predict(output_margin=True) and native XGBoost output_margin=True; expit(margin) should match probability predictions. Persist score space in model/NPZ/cache/working-point metadata.
Raw margins are real-valued, not restricted to [0,1]; verify histogram coverage, efficiency mapping and storage thresholds using negative and positive margins.

Record explicit MC training selection 2.95<mass<3.02 and disjoint data background outside this window, including boundary policy; training and validation must share the same role-specific selections without promoting Hyper sidebands to Femto pair sidebands.

Recompute frozen MC feature support after the convention correction. Inspect before/after selection counts and cosPA/radius QA; do not fix the old distorted distribution with an artificial cosPA cut or clipping.

Re-evaluate the MC-tail fit quality, S3/eff pol0 consistency and 3sigma objective argmax after the changed physical derivation and retraining. Old probabilities/BDT thresholds and fit-quality numbers are superseded.
